brand_voice_note: Reflective and grounding, quietly craft-confident, speaking to identity and daily ritual rather than trend or hype.

copy_claims: Cores are cut from real minerals like amethyst
ion plated gold snake chain runs through the top to hold the core
concepts.primary_text:
We wanted one piece that would change with you as you change in life.

So we machined a brass frame and cut a real amethyst core to sit inside it, held in place by the ion plated gold chain that runs straight through the top.

Swap the core to match your outfit, your vibe, or carry a specific stone with you. Make it your own.
concepts.headline: Machined frame, a real cut stone
concepts.why_it_works: Only this brand can show a machined brass barrel with a hand-cut mineral core being assembled on a maker's bench, which is the structurally unique story no competitor can copy.
concepts.visual_direction: The brass pendant resting on a jeweller's workbench beside a raw amethyst offcut, metal shavings and steel tweezers, showing how it was made.

copy_claims: made with stainless steel, Cerakote finish
concepts.primary_text:
Worried a black finish will scuff and fade? This one is built differently.

The black gateway is stainless steel under a Cerakote finish, and the snake chain is hypoallergenic against your skin.

Pick your length, swap the stone whenever the mood changes. It's a great companion along the way.
concepts.headline: A black finish built to hold up
concepts.why_it_works: The obvious hesitation with matte black jewellery is that it will wear off, so we answer that head-on with the actual material spec on the frame.
concepts.visual_direction: The matte black pendant lying on dark slate with its chain coiled beside it, and four thin labels pointing to the finish, chain, lengths and stone.

copy_claims: swap the stone core in seconds
concepts.primary_text:
One necklace. A different stone whenever your mood shifts.

Slide the chain out, tip the core out, drop a new one in and go about your day. Swap stones in seconds to match your mood, intention, or style.

A hypoallergenic stainless steel snake chain comes with it, so it lives against your skin all day.
concepts.headline: Change the stone, not the necklace
concepts.why_it_works: The single most desirable thing about this piece is the moment of the swap, so we show that exact action instead of describing it.
concepts.visual_direction: An open hand at a sunlit dressing table sliding the Labradorite core out of the slim steel pendant, with a second core resting on the oak beside it.
